subject: Trial runway: stretch SLA concessions & discount pathway
messages:
From: Emily Rios <emily@quetzal.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — short runway extension?

Alex — thanks for the demo earlier. The PoC is looking good but we hit a scheduling snag: our ML team needs another 2–3 weeks to finish the dataset refresh and run the final latency tests. Our internal PM asked whether Redwood can stretch the trial window instead of swapping for credits — we want as few moving pieces as possible.

Can you share the options you can approve from your side (length, discount, SLA bump, and whether engineering support hours are included)? We’re trying to avoid a full contract amendment if possible.

Attached: quetzal-poc-usage.csv (sample burn rate for last 2 weeks).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this afternoon if it helps.

Emily Rios
Head of ML Programs | Quetzal AI
emily@quetzal.ai | +1 415-555-0187

---
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Rios <emily@quetzal.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short runway extension?

Emily — really glad the demo landed well. Appreciate the usage file; that helps a lot. Two pragmatic paths we can offer without a heavy amendment: 

1) Short extension + token credit (fast approval)
   - 14 extra days added to the current trial window
   - $0 charge, but no change to discounts or billing rates
   - Includes 2 x office-hours with our SREs to help run latency tests

2) Longer stretch + discount + SLA uplift (needs finance sign-off)
   - 30 extra days on top of the trial
   - One-time 10% discount on the first month if you convert to a paid plan within 30 days after trial
   - Temporary SLA uplift: 99.5% targeting for the trial period and priority queueing for support tickets
   - Includes up to 8 hours of dedicated engineering time for integration/perf tuning

If you prefer not to touch billing, option 1 is the quickest. Option 2 is a little heavier but gives you engineering time and a conversion incentive. I’m looping in Monica (cc) to confirm what finance can greenlight for this deal window. Also looping in David for the SRE availability.

Next step: tell me which option you prefer and whether Quetzal would consider the 30-day conversion trigger in option 2. I’ll scope the short DocuSign addendum for whichever we pick.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Attachment: proposal_v1.pdf (outline of option 2 terms)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Emily Rios <emily@quetzal.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-31T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short runway extension?

Emily / Alex — quick finance note from my side: we can approve a one-off extension with a modest commercial concession without a full amendment, subject to the following guardrails:

- For extensions <= 14 days: legal addendum OK, no commercial charge, approval at ACM level (no exec review).
- For extensions > 14 and <= 30 days with a conversion incentive (10%): requires approval from Revenue Ops; we can fast-track if Quetzal confirms intent to evaluate conversion within 30 days post-trial and signs the addendum with billing terms (net-30).
- Any included eng hours (>=4) will be invoiced as pre-authorized professional services if not converted within 60 days — we need that to avoid open OPEX risk.

I attached the proposal_v1.pdf with the wording we’d use in the short addendum. If Quetzal is comfortable with the conversion trigger language (simple clause: convert within 30 days to receive discount; otherwise discount void), we can sign and DocuSign by EOD tomorrow.

David — can you confirm SRE availability for a pair of 3–4 hour blocks next week if Emily opts for the longer stretch?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachment: proposal_v1.pdf (addendum draft)
From: Emily Rios <emily@quetzal.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short runway extension?

Thanks, everyone — appreciate the clear options. Quetzal prefers a middle path: 21 extra days (3 weeks) so our data pipeline catches up, and we’ll accept a one-time 10% conversion discount with a 30-day conversion window. We’re comfortable with the engineering-hour guardrail Monica noted — we’ll aim to convert if results look good.

Can Alex send the short addendum reflecting: 21-day extension, 10% conversion discount if converted within 30 days, 6 hours of dedicated engineering support (two 3-hr blocks), and net-30 billing for the subsequent paid contract? If you can DocuSign that, we’ll countersign. Also happy to schedule the SRE blocks: David, are mornings PT next Tuesday/Thursday ok?

Best,
Emily Rios
Head of ML Programs | Quetzal AI
